simple.prompt: Subordinating clause of condition: 'The policy will proceed, ___ that key stakeholder approvals are obtained.'
simple.explanation: 'Provided that' / 'Providing that' adalah konjungsi subordinat formal yang bermakna 'as long as' (asalkan/dengan syarat).
hints: Bermakna 'asalkan' / 'dengan syarat'.
Gunakan 'provided'.

simple.prompt: Subordination of reason: '___ the regulatory body has issued new directives, all procedures must be adjusted.'
simple.explanation: 'Inasmuch as' adalah konjungsi subordinasi formal yang digunakan untuk menyatakan alasan/fakta pendukung ('mengingat bahwa').
hints: Bermakna formal 'mengingat bahwa'.
Gunakan 'Inasmuch as'.

simple.targetSentence: Domestic inflation stabilized whereas international energy costs continued to surge.
simple.explanation: Domestic inflation stabilized + whereas international energy costs continued to surge.
hints: Klausa utama: 'Domestic inflation stabilized'.
Klausa subordinasi kontras: 'whereas international energy costs continued to surge'.

simple.prompt: Concession clause: '___ hard they negotiated, no consensus could be forged.'
simple.explanation: 'However + adjective/adverb + subject + verb' bermakna 'betapapun...': 'However hard they negotiated...'.
hints: Pola: However + adverb + subjek + verb.
Gunakan 'However'.

simple.targetSentence: He spoke with authority as though he had witnessed the incident.
simple.explanation: He spoke with authority + as though he had witnessed the incident.
hints: Mulai dengan 'He spoke with authority'.
Klausa subordinat cara: 'as though he had witnessed the incident'.

simple.prompt: Negative condition: 'The transaction will not close ___ the seller rectifies the title defects.'
hints: Bermakna 'kecuali jika'.
Gunakan 'unless'.

simple.targetSentence: Even though revenue declined profitability remained resilient throughout the quarter.
simple.explanation: Even though revenue declined + profitability remained resilient throughout the quarter.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Even though revenue declined'.
Klausa utama: 'profitability remained resilient throughout the quarter'.

simple.prompt: The regional clinic will expand evening hours ___ additional nursing funds are approved by Friday.
simple.explanation: 'Provided that' menyatakan syarat tegas ('dengan ketentuan bahwa / asalkan').
hints: Hubungan antar-klausa adalah syarat persetujuan dana.
Pilih konjungsi syarat formal 'provided that'.

simple.prompt: ___ the coastal freight terminal operates round the clock, inland rail depots close at ten.
simple.explanation: 'Whereas' mengontraskan dua kondisi atau kebijakan yang berjalan berlawanan.
hints: Dua lokasi dibandingkan karena jam operasionalnya bertolak belakang.
Gunakan subordinator kontras 'Whereas'.

simple.prompt: We included a manual override valve ___ the automated sensor loses power.
simple.explanation: 'In the event that' adalah konjungsi formal antisipasi/syarat ('apabila / seandainya terjadi').
hints: Katup manual dipasang sebagai langkah antisipasi.
Penghubung formal skenario tak terduga: 'in the event that'.

simple.prompt: ___ strict cost caps, the architecture team delivered an airy daylight atrium.
simple.explanation: 'Even though' wajib diikuti klausa lengkap (Subject + Verb: 'they faced'); 'Despite' tidak boleh diikuti klausa langsung.
hints: Lihat apakah klausa di pilihan memakai Subject + Verb.
'Despite' salah jika langsung diikuti klausa penuh 'they faced'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog kebijakan kontrak tentang syarat waktu negatif.
dialogue: Supplier
Will this wholesale discount remain active all year?
Buyer
Yes, ___ minimum monthly shipments drop below two hundred crates.
simple.explanation: 'Unless' menyatakan syarat pengecualian negatif ('kecuali jika pengiriman bulanan turun di bawah 200 peti').
hints: Diskon tetap berlaku, kecuali kondisi penurunan terjadi.
Syarat negatif memakai 'unless'.

simple.prompt: ___ all preliminary safety checklists have been verified, construction crews may enter Sector 4.
simple.explanation: 'Now that' (= karena sekarang sudah) memperkenalkan sebab baru yang sudah tercapai untuk mengizinkan langkah berikutnya.
hints: Daftar cek keselamatan sudah terverifikasi sekarang.
'Now that' menyatakan sebab akibat kondisi terkini.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggalan anak kalimat (sentence fragment) yang dibiarkan berdiri sendiri berikut.
simple.draft: Although the initial coastal prototype resisted salt corrosion remarkably well during winter trials.
options: Although the initial coastal prototype resisted salt corrosion remarkably well during winter trials, long-term data remains necessary.
Because the initial coastal prototype resisted salt corrosion remarkably well during winter trials.
Despite the initial coastal prototype resisted salt corrosion remarkably well during winter trials.
simple.explanation: Subordinating conjunction ('Although...') tidak boleh berdiri sendirian tanpa klausa utama (fragment); gabungkan dengan klausa utama setelah koma.
hints: Subordinator 'Although' menjadikan seluruh kalimat baru anak kalimat.
Wajib ada klausa utama sebagai induk kalimat.

simple.prompt: Please adjust the calibration curve ___ the manual specifies in Appendix A.
simple.explanation: 'Just as' berfungsi sebagai subordinator cara ('persis sebagaimana dijelaskan dalam lampiran').
hints: Menunjukkan cara mengikuti pedoman manual.
Subordinator cara adalah 'just as'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat subordinasi syarat formal memakai 'on condition that'.
simple.targetSentence: The landlord extended our studio lease on condition that we maintain quiet evenings.
simple.explanation: Klausa utama diikuti konjungsi syarat 'on condition that' + klausa lengkap.
hints: Awali dengan 'The landlord extended our studio lease'.
Tambahkan klausa syarat 'on condition that...'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat subordinasi sebab formal menggunakan 'inasmuch as' atau 'given that'.
simple.targetSentence: Given that winter demand surged early, our logistics hub hired extra drivers.
simple.explanation: 'Given that + clause' memperkenalkan fakta dasar yang menjadi alasan klausa utama.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Given that winter demand surged early,'.
Lanjutkan dengan akibatnya di klausa utama.

dialogue: Legal Director
Is the arbitration ruling legally binding on both parties?
Counsel
Yes, ___ that neither signatory files an appeal within thirty days.
intermediate.explanation: 'Subject to the proviso that...' adalah frasa subordinasi yuridis formal untuk menyatakan syarat penentu.
hints: Frasa hukum formal 'dengan ketentuan bahwa'.
Gunakan 'subject to the proviso'.

intermediate.prompt: Temporal subordination: 'Hardly had the decree been announced ___ protests erupted in the capital.'
hints: Pasangan baku 'Hardly' adalah 'when'.
Gunakan 'when'.

intermediate.prompt: Correlative concession: '___ much as we value your feedback, company policy cannot be amended retroactively.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Inasmuch as' atau 'Much as we value...' menyatakan konsesi kuat ('meskipun kami sangat menghargai...').
hints: Frasa subordinasi 'Inasmuch as' / 'Much as'.
Pilih 'In' (Inasmuch as).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat bersyarat ganda 'on the condition that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Funds were released on the condition that external audits be conducted.
intermediate.explanation: Funds were released + on the condition that + external audits be conducted (subjunctive).
hints: Mulai dengan 'Funds were released'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'on the condition that external audits be conducted'.

intermediate.prompt: Double subordinating embedding: 'The commission determined that ___ the allegations were substantiated, punitive action would follow.'
intermediate.explanation: 'In the event that' (seandainya/jika terjadi) berfungsi sebagai klausa kondisional subordinat formal di dalam klausa komplemen 'that'.
hints: Frasa kondisional formal di dalam klausa komplementer.
Gunakan 'in the event that'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat subordinat bersyarat 'In the event that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: In the event that negotiations stall the mediator will propose arbitration.
intermediate.explanation: In the event that negotiations stall + the mediator will propose arbitration.
hints: Mulai dengan 'In the event that negotiations stall'.
Klausa konsekuensi: 'the mediator will propose arbitration'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog diplomasi dengan subordinasi konsesif.
dialogue: Ambassador
Will the bilateral treaty survive the current border dispute?
Envoy
___ tense relations appear, strategic economic interests will prevail.
intermediate.explanation: 'However + adj (tense) + subjek + verb' bermakna 'betapapun tegangnya hubungan yang tampak'.
hints: Pola: However + adjective + clause.
Gunakan 'However'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ convincing the executive summary sounded, the audit board requested raw transaction ledgers.
intermediate.explanation: Pola formal 'However + Adjective + Subject + Verb' bermakna 'Betapapun [meyakinkan]-nya ringkasan itu...'.
hints: Perhatikan adjective 'convincing' berada langsung setelah rumpang.
Pola 'However + adj + S + V' tidak memerlukan 'that'.

intermediate.prompt: Keep the thermal gasket sealed tightly ___ moisture compromise the optical array.
intermediate.explanation: Konjungsi formal 'lest' (= agar jangan sampai) secara tradisional berpasangan dengan bentuk subjunctive tanpa -s ('compromise' setelah subjek tunggal 'moisture').
hints: Lihat verb 'compromise' tanpa '-s' meski subjeknya 'moisture' (subjunctive).
Konjungsi formal antisipasi risiko adalah 'lest'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi penyuntingan naskah hukum mengenai 'insofar as'.
dialogue: Partner
Does Section 8 shield sub-contractors from all liability?
Associate
Only ___ they followed written municipal inspection procedures.
intermediate.explanation: 'Insofar as' adalah subordinator presisi hukum dan akademik bermakna 'sejauh mana / sepanjang batas bahwa...'.
hints: Membatasi cakupan berlakunya pasal hukum.
Konjungsi pembatas cakupan: 'insofar as'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ the city upgrades its suburban bus fleet, outer-ring commuters will continue relying on motorbikes.
intermediate.explanation: Hubungan logis 'Jika kota tidak meningkatkan armada bus, pemudik akan terus memakai motor' memakai 'Unless' (= if ... not).
hints: Klausa kedua menggambarkan konsekuensi jika aksi pertama tidak dilakukan.
Gunakan 'Unless'.

intermediate.prompt: Much ___ I respect our consultant's track record, her proposed timeline appears overly optimistic.
intermediate.explanation: Konstruksi konsesif formal di awal kalimat mengikuti pola 'Much as + Subject + Verb' ('Meskipun saya sangat menghormati...').
hints: Pola idiomatik konsesif dengan 'Much': 'Much as + S + V'.
Jangan memakai 'Much although'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan subordinator ganda dan fragmen pada kalimat laporan kebijakan berikut.
intermediate.draft: Whereas renewable capacity doubled in northern provinces, yet rural transmission bottlenecks prevented full distribution.
options: Whereas renewable capacity doubled in northern provinces, rural transmission bottlenecks prevented full distribution.
Although renewable capacity doubled in northern provinces, but rural transmission bottlenecks prevented full distribution.
Despite renewable capacity doubled in northern provinces, rural transmission bottlenecks prevented full distribution.
intermediate.explanation: Di depan sudah ada subordinator 'Whereas', sehingga jangan menyisipkan 'yet' atau 'but' di antara koma dan klausa utama.
hints: Satu hubungan kontras cukup memakai satu konjungsi.
Hapus kata 'yet' setelah koma.

intermediate.prompt: The museum agreed to lend the rare astrolabe ___ it be displayed inside a climate-controlled case.
intermediate.explanation: 'On condition that + subject + bare verb (be)' menggabungkan syarat formal dengan mandative subjunctive.
hints: Lihat bare infinitive 'be' setelah 'it' (subjunctive syarat).
Pilih konjungsi syarat formal 'on condition that'.

intermediate.prompt: She spoke about the merger ___ she had negotiated every single clause personally.
intermediate.explanation: 'As though' / 'as if' + Past Perfect ('had negotiated') menyatakan perbandingan cara yang bersifat imajiner atau tak sesuai kenyataan.
hints: Menunjukkan cara berbicara 'seolah-olah dia sendiri yang merundingkan'.
Pilih 'as though'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat subordinasi berpasangan korelatif 'so ... that' dengan inversi 'So'.
intermediate.targetSentence: So severe was the harbor fog that all morning departures were suspended.
intermediate.explanation: 'So + Adjective + Verb + Subject + that...' menekankan tingginya intensitas sebab.
hints: Awali dengan 'So severe was the harbor fog'.
Sambungkan dengan klausa akibat 'that all morning departures were suspended'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat konsesif memakai struktur formal 'Try as...'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Try as the logistics team might, they could not clear customs before dusk.
intermediate.explanation: Konstruksi 'Try as + Subject + might/may' bermakna 'Sekeras apa pun mereka berusaha...'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Try as the logistics team might,'.
Lengkapi klausa hasil negatifnya.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan struktur bertingkat (nested subordination) yang kehilangan verba utama.
complex.draft: Although the fiscal indicators which were monitored by the reserve bank since the beginning of the monetary tightening cycle.
options: Although the fiscal indicators were monitored by the reserve bank, inflationary pressures persisted.
The fiscal indicators which were monitored by the reserve bank since the tightening cycle.
Although monitoring fiscal indicators by the reserve bank was tightening.
complex.explanation: Kalimat aslinya adalah fragmen tanpa klausa utama (sentence fragment). Klausa subordinat 'Although...' harus dilengkapi dengan klausa utama independen lengkap: 'inflationary pressures persisted'.
hints: Perbaiki kalimat fragmen agar memiliki klausa utama lengkap.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Analyze the syntactic structure: 'Lest the market panic, the central bank issued an emergency liquidity guarantee.' The clause 'Lest the market panic' functions as...
options: a negative purpose clause taking the mandative subjunctive
complex.explanation: 'Lest + subject + subjunctive base verb' adalah klausa subordinasi tujuan negatif formal yang bermakna 'agar tidak / jangan sampai...'.
hints: Klausa tujuan negatif dengan subjunctive.
Pilih 'a negative purpose clause taking the mandative subjunctive'.

complex.prompt: Recursive embedding in legal drafting: Why do professional legal drafters restrict subordination to a maximum of 2-3 levels?
options: To prevent cognitive overload and catastrophic ambiguity in statutory interpretation.
Because subordinate clauses are banned by the Bar Association.
To make the text easier to translate into Latin.
complex.explanation: Penyusunan klausa subordinasi berlapis-lapis (recursive embedding) tanpa batas dapat menciptakan ambiguitas penafsiran hukum yang fatal dan membingungkan pembaca.
hints: Mencegah beban kognitif berlebih dan ambiguitas hukum.
Pilih opsi cognitive overload and ambiguity.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal tujuan negatif dengan 'Lest'.
complex.targetSentence: The diplomat guarded his words lest his intentions be misconstrued.
complex.explanation: The diplomat guarded his words + lest his intentions be misconstrued (subjunctive).
hints: Klausa utama: 'The diplomat guarded his words'.
Klausa tujuan negatif: 'lest his intentions be misconstrued'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki pemilihan kata sambung subordinat pada klausa kontras berlawanan.
complex.draft: The junior analysts were dismissed, while that the senior partner retained his equity stake.
options: The junior analysts were dismissed, whereas the senior partner retained his equity stake.
The junior analysts were dismissed, while that the partner retained equity.
The junior analysts were dismissed despite that the senior partner retained equity.
complex.explanation: Gunakan 'whereas' (atau 'while' murni tanpa 'that') untuk menyandingkan dua nasib yang kontras tajam. Frasa 'while that' keliru dalam bahasa Inggris baku.
hints: Gunakan 'whereas' murni tanpa 'that'.
Ganti 'while that' menjadi 'whereas'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence displaying flawless complex correlative subordination:
options: Not only did the policy fail to curb inflation, but it also, insofar as empirical data reveals, exacerbated income inequality.
Not only the policy failed to curb inflation, but also it exacerbated inequality.
Insofar not only did the policy fail, but it also exacerbated.
complex.explanation: Kalimat ini menggabungkan inversi korelatif 'Not only did... but it also' dengan sisipan klausa subordinasi pembatas 'insofar as empirical data reveals' secara elegan dan gramatikal.
hints: Kombinasi inversi korelatif dan sisipan subordinasi presisi.
Pilih opsi pertama.

dialogue: Arbiter
Under what stipulation will the hearing proceed in camera?
Lead Counsel
___ that trade secrets would otherwise be irrevocably exposed.
options: Inasmuch as it has been demonstrated
complex.explanation: 'Inasmuch as it has been demonstrated that...' (mengingat telah terbukti bahwa...) adalah konstruksi subordinasi formal pembuka argumen yuridis.
hints: Konstruksi pembuka yuridis formal.
Gunakan 'Inasmuch as it has been demonstrated'.

complex.prompt: Examine nested subordination clarity: 'Although the committee approved funding, ___ that field conditions remained unstable, engineers proceeded cautiously.'
complex.explanation: Klausa sisipan bertingkat (nested subordination) wajib membentuk struktur klausa utuh yang paralel agar tidak terputus secara sintaksis ('even though early surveys warned that...').
hints: Pastikan klausa sisipan di antara koma memiliki Subject + Verb untuk klausa 'that...'.
Cek kelengkapan gramatikal anak kalimat sisipan.

complex.prompt: In statutory drafting, '___ any provision herein be declared invalid, the remaining clauses shall continue in full force' illustrates formal conditional inversion with...
complex.explanation: Dalam hukum modern dan kontrak resmi, 'Should any provision herein be declared...' (= If any provision should be declared...) adalah pembuka syarat formal standar.
hints: Perhatikan verb dasar 'be declared' di belakang subjek 'any provision'.
Inversi syarat formal diawali 'Should'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan kepadatan anak kalimat berlapis (subordination density) yang membingungkan dan hilang kata kerja utama berikut.
complex.draft: While the audit report which the regional office commissioned when tax rules shifted last autumn, though preliminary.
options: While preliminary, the audit report commissioned by the regional office when tax rules shifted last autumn clarified key compliance gaps.
While the audit report which the regional office commissioned when tax rules shifted last autumn, although preliminary.
Because the audit report which the regional office commissioned when tax rules shifted last autumn, though preliminary.
complex.explanation: Kalimat asal adalah sentence fragment panjang tanpa main verb untuk klausa utama! Ringkas anak kalimat bertumpuk ('which the regional office commissioned' → 'commissioned by...') dan berikan predikat utama yang jelas ('clarified key compliance gaps').
hints: Kalimat asal tidak punya main verb utama di luar anak kalimat.
Pastikan tersedia subjek + predikat utama yang tegas dan ringkas.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi akademik tentang membedakan 'whether ... or' (ketidakpastian/alternatif) vs 'if'.
dialogue: Editor
Your thesis says 'Policy outcomes differ depending on if subsidies target transit or fuel.' Should we refine 'if'?
Advisor
Definitely — directly after a preposition like 'on', formal style mandates ___.
options: whether subsidies target transit or fuel
that subsidies target transit or fuel
despite subsidies target transit or fuel
complex.explanation: Setelah preposisi ('depending on...', 'concerning...', 'as to...'), klausa alternatif TIDAK boleh memakai 'if'; bahasa Inggris baku mewajibkan 'whether (... or ...)'.
hints: Kata depan 'on' tidak bisa langsung diikuti 'if'.
Gunakan 'whether' setelah preposisi.

complex.prompt: The compliance board declined the variance request, ___ the applicant had complied with prior safety inspections.
complex.explanation: 'Notwithstanding that + clause' berfungsi sebagai subordinator konsesif hukum yang berarti 'meskipun kenyataannya bahwa...'.
hints: Diikuti klausa lengkap ('the applicant had complied...') dengan makna konsesi hukum.
Pilih 'notwithstanding that'.

complex.prompt: ___ did the dual-hull ferry handle crosswinds that passengers scarcely noticed the gale.
complex.explanation: Pola inversi korelatif 'So + adverb + did + Subject + V1 + that...' memicu inversi saat frasa intensitas diletakkan di awal kalimat.
hints: Pola inversi korelatif: 'So + adverb + auxiliary + S + V1 + that...'.
Pilih 'So effortlessly'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk modal/subjunctive di dalam klausa 'lest' berikut.
complex.draft: Inspectors flagged the hairline valve leak early lest pressurized steam wouldn't rupture the secondary pipe.
options: Inspectors flagged the hairline valve leak early lest pressurized steam rupture the secondary pipe.
Inspectors flagged the hairline valve leak early lest pressurized steam didn't rupture the secondary pipe.
Inspectors flagged the hairline valve leak early lest pressurized steam will not rupture the secondary pipe.
complex.explanation: 'Lest' SUDAH mengandung makna negatif ('agar jangan sampai'); menambahkan 'wouldn't/didn't/not' menciptakan negatif ganda yang merusak arti, dan formalitasnya memakai subjunctive ('rupture') atau 'should rupture'.
hints: 'Lest' berarti 'so that ... not', jadi jangan diisi 'not' lagi.
Hapus negasi dan pakai bare subjunctive 'rupture'.

complex.prompt: No matter ___ persuasive a preliminary dataset appears, longitudinal validation remains indispensable.
complex.explanation: Sebelum adjective ('persuasive') pada pola konsesi umum, gunakan 'No matter how + adjective + Subject + Verb'.
hints: Diikuti langsung oleh adjective 'persuasive'.
Pasangan baku: 'No matter how + adj'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai klausa 'lest' + subjunctive.
complex.targetSentence: Engineers installed redundant pressure seals lest thermal expansion compromise the hull.
complex.explanation: 'Lest' langsung diikuti subjek tunggal ('thermal expansion') + bare verb subjunctive ('compromise') tanpa -s.
hints: Awali dengan 'Engineers installed redundant pressure seals'.
Sambungkan dengan 'lest thermal expansion compromise the hull'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat hukum/akademis memakai 'insofar as' sebagai pembatas klausa.
complex.targetSentence: Automated scoring assists instructors insofar as it flags structural patterns objectively.
complex.explanation: 'Insofar as' membatasi sejauh mana klausa pertama berlaku.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Automated scoring assists instructors'.
Tambahkan pembatas 'insofar as it flags structural patterns objectively'.
